Hello everyone! We are hosting a competition to give Erene a brand-new colour scheme! Anyone can participate in this competition, so long as you have access to Paint.NET or any equivalent drawing program.

[b]So, what are the rules?[/b]
- You can't change the shape of the continents
- You can add details to make the map look more intricate and interesting
- You can change the colours of the map to be whatever you please!

[b]Periods[/b]
We will give everyone a week to create their submissions. Submit a PNG of your design and its PDN file in our Discord server @ discord.gg/EA8MVKFYYR once you're ready.

Once we close submissions, on the 19th of March (UTC+), we will host a vote to select the new look for our map. The proposal with the most votes wins the competition!

[b]Resources[/b]
If you need a copy of Erene to work from, you can find our open-source release for the map's master file here under the section "Be your Own Cartographer":
https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2605235

Good luck, everyone!
